mathematical_contract.retained_cut: An interior local parameter retains the exact contact predicate that orders it against every represented rational semicircle parameter. Structural endpoints remain represented zero or one. No primitive element is formed for independent selected cusp roots.
mathematical_contract.proof_identity: Repeated wrappers around the same map allocation, contact evidence, operand side, and overlap boundary compare equal structurally. Exact represented bracket witnesses compare directly. Unrelated mapped evidence is never declared exactly equal from overlapping intervals alone.
mathematical_contract.ordering: Distinct mapped parameters are refined through certified dyadic brackets until the intervals separate. Exact rational witnesses terminate immediately. The maximum bounded-refinement target is derived from Hyperlimit's -512 precision boundary.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT returns explicit Ordering uncertainty when unrelated evidence still overlaps at the 512-bit boundary. APPROXIMATE_512 records terminal consumption and interprets the remaining overlap as equality, matching Hyperlimit's terminal zero interpretation. Evidence created under one predicate policy cannot be replayed under the other.
mathematical_contract.subfragment: A fragment stores one selected semicircle, an ascending pair of exact cuts, and one traversal bit behind a shared pointer. Construction proves start < end and containment in [0,1]. A strict rational between the cuts supplies an exact evaluation witness without materializing either boundary field.
mathematical_contract.bounds: The current fragment bound reuses the exact conservative bound of its full supporting semicircle. This is safe but intentionally not yet a tight subrange bound.
